structured.answer: I'd open a פסגות trading account and put the money each month into "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". The page marks it "הזול", says it has 0% management fee, and shows it leaving about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years on 70,000 ₪ put in. I'm fairly sure, but I've never heard of ילין לפידות, so I'd still want to look them up.

stuck.where: Popup 'מס רק במכירה' on the left side
stuck.why: It popped up right away and stayed on every screen while I scrolled. The whole page behind it looked dark, and it covered the left side of the fund list, where the shekel differences are.

stuck.where: Top of the page, the amounts boxes
stuck.why: It was set to 10,000 today and 500 a month, not my 30,000. I didn't change it, so the 86,492 isn't really my number.
ילין לפידות doesn't ring a bell, but it's the one marked as the pick. פסגות I know, so that helped.
Numbers like −447 ₪ and −4,492 ₪. I guessed it's how much less you end up with compared to the cheapest fund, but the minus signs scared me off those.
